trans.sense: straight tapering rod used to impel the balls in games such as billiards, snooker, and pool

raw_glosses: (sports, billiards, snooker, pool) A straight tapering stick used to hit the balls in various games.
glosses: A straight tapering stick used to hit the balls in various games.

examples.text: Fat, short, radiant, General Chattesworth—in full, artillery uniform—was there, smiling, and making little speeches to the ladies, and bowing stiffly from his hips upward—his great cue playing all the time up and down his back, and sometimes so near the ground when he stood erect and threw back his head, that Toole, seeing Juno eyeing the appendage rather viciously, thought it prudent to cut her speculations short with a smart kick.
